statement: Workflow runs are restart-safe, single-writer and permanently bound to graphKey plus graphVersion.
Workers write domain facts and correlated signals while the orchestrator exclusively owns Graph-path routing.
The Web projection is authoritative, task actions are payload-gated and the export copy preserves the future iOS importer boundary.
A main push deploys a commit-addressed Node 24 image through the repository-scoped trusted Woodpecker agent.
The protected Cloudflare and Nginx boundary requires Basic Auth, same-origin API routing, private storage and exact RustFS CORS.
Rollback replaces only application services and preserves database, checkpoint, Outbox, Redis and object-storage state.
